Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low urine specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
